title: The Drunk Train
cn: 第 16 集 · 醉酒列车
novel: Lily and Marshall [[invited|invite]] Robin and Kevin to join them on a trip to Vermont. They wanted to spend a [[relaxing|relaxing]] weekend in the countryside. Robin and Kevin agreed to go, hoping it would be a nice [[getaway|getaway]]. On the train ride there, they had a few drinks and enjoyed each other's company. Meanwhile, Kevin and Robin [[discussed|discuss]] their [[relationship|relationship]] during the trip. Kevin felt that things were getting [[serious|serious]] between them. He wanted to know where their relationship was going. Robin was [[hesitant|hesitant]] to talk about the future. She was still dealing with her feelings for Barney. Kevin noticed her [[hesitation|hesitation]] and asked if something was wrong. Robin tried to [[reassure|reassure]] him but could not fully [[commit|commit]] to their future. Meanwhile, Barney went out with some friends and [[encountered|encounter]] a woman who seemed to be his perfect match. She was clever, [[confident|confident]], and could match Barney's wit. Barney was [[intrigued|intrigue]] by her [[intelligence|intelligence]] and [[charm|charm]]. They spent the evening talking and laughing together. Barney felt something he had not felt in a long time. The trip to Vermont was not as [[relaxing|relaxing]] as Lily had hoped. Marshall accidentally broke a window at the cabin. Kevin and Robin's conversation about their future was [[tense|tense]] and [[unresolved|unresolved]]. Despite everything, the friends [[agreed|agree]] that being together was what mattered most.

reassure.en: to make someone feel less worried

intelligence.en: the ability to learn and think
